trigger.message: Skill 'devops-agent-cost-insights' was NOT triggered (no skills were loaded)

expected_output.reasoning: The agent's response aligns closely with the expected output. It correctly states that tool call activity (AWS and third-party) can be reported from the journal for this investigation. It correctly states that direct agent execution cost / billed agent-seconds cannot be reported because the only seconds figure (600s) is an aggregate at the Agent Space + day level shared across multiple investigations and chats, with no allocation key to split it. It explicitly warns against fabricating an estimate (dividing evenly or by call-count), matching the expected criterion that the 600 seconds should not be assigned or prorated to this investigation. It does not substitute wall-clock duration for billed agent-seconds - it never invents a duration-based cost figure. All key elements of the expected output are present: attributable tool activity reportable, direct agent cost unavailable, aggregate not prorated, no wall-clock substitution.

assertion_results.text: Investigation-specific tool and attributable downstream activity may be reported
assertion_results.evidence: "Tool call activity — the journal shows which AWS API calls and third-party tool calls this investigation made, so you can enumerate what it did (e.g., "queried CloudWatch metrics 3 times, called Datadog logs API twice")." and "Downstream API call cost, if you separately have per-call pricing — since the journal identifies the specific calls, those can be costed individually."
assertion_results.reasoning: The agent explicitly states that investigation-specific tool call activity and attributable downstream API call costs can be reported for this investigation.

assertion_results.text: Direct agent cost for the individual investigation is reported as unavailable
assertion_results.evidence: "Direct agent execution cost / billed agent-seconds for this investigation — the journal has no execution-level billed-seconds data... Cannot be reported"
assertion_results.reasoning: The agent clearly categorizes direct agent execution cost/billed-seconds for this investigation as something that cannot be reported, matching the assertion.

assertion_results.text: The 600 daily Agent Space seconds are not allocated or prorated to one investigation
assertion_results.evidence: "attempting to divide 600s evenly or by call-count across investigations would be a fabricated estimate, not a fact from the supplied data. Doing so would misrepresent an aggregate metric as an investigation-level one."
assertion_results.reasoning: The agent explicitly refuses to allocate or prorate the 600s figure to the individual investigation, calling any such allocation fabricated.

assertion_results.text: Wall-clock execution duration is not treated as billed agent-seconds
assertion_results.evidence: The agent never conflates wall-clock duration with billed agent-seconds; it states there is 'no execution-level billed-seconds data' and does not substitute any timing/duration figure as a stand-in for billed seconds.
assertion_results.reasoning: While the agent doesn't explicitly discuss 'wall-clock execution duration' as a separate concept, it consistently avoids treating any duration measure as billed agent-seconds, only referencing the aggregate 600s metric which it explicitly declines to use as a per-investigation billed-seconds proxy. No wall-clock time is presented as billed seconds anywhere in the response.

assertion_results.text: A complete per-investigation total is not presented without execution-level billed seconds
assertion_results.evidence: "you can give a tool-usage-based cost breakdown for this investigation, but the agent-time cost line has to be reported as 'not available at the investigation level — only a Space-wide total of 600s exists for the day, shared across several investigations and chats.'"
assertion_results.reasoning: The agent explicitly states that a complete per-investigation total (including the agent-time/execution cost line) is not presented, since that component is marked as unavailable rather than filled in with an estimate or aggregate substitute.
